entries.peakOff: Peak/off-peak pricing is off; base prices are used
entries.peakNotEffective: Not yet effective (effective at {time}); base prices are currently used
entries.peakActive: Peak hour now; peak prices apply
entries.peakNotice: DeepSeek peak-hour pricing is active; current calls are billed at peak prices
entries.weekendAllOffPeak: Weekend — all off-peak (Sat & Sun billed at off-peak prices all day)
entries.holidayAllOffPeak: Chinese public holiday — off-peak all day
entries.weekendRuleNote: Since Aug 23, 2026 (Beijing time), weekends and Chinese public holidays are off-peak all day, including work-shift weekends.
entries.peakAlertBody: Billing switches to {phase} pricing in about {time}; mind your call costs in this window.
entries.peakAlertWebNotifyHint: When enabled, allow notification permission in the browser address bar so you get alerted even when the page is minimized or backgrounded.
entries.peakNoticeHiddenHint: Notice hidden: enable peak/off-peak pricing and the “prominent notice” toggle.
entries.sidebarSimpleNote: Condense cards but keep amounts, quotas and hover details. Height is capped at 38% of the viewport with scrolling. Turn off to restore.
entries.sidebarSimpleBody: Simple display leaves more room for conversations. Enable it now? You can change it in Settings → Cost → Display anytime.
entries.sidebarSimpleError: Settings could not be saved. Retry or dismiss this guide and change them later in Settings.
entries.removePriceMatchHint: Remove clears the override and hides the row until restored. Usage records are kept; automatic price matching applies.
entries.priceLockHint: You edited this price manually; auto-sync will not overwrite it.
